# pkg_regex: # majors = installed SDK majors the entry applies to. kind: removed | renamed | inert | deprecated | changed-default | platform-gated. when: optional unit predicate (platform:macos, role:library ...).

name: enableTracing
message: Removed in 9.0; use options.traceSampleRate or options.tracesSampler instead.

name: autoAppStart
message: Removed in 9.0; App Start Instrumentation is on by default and determines the end of app start itself, so delete the option.

name: setAppStartEnd
message: Removed in 9.0; delete the call, since App Start Instrumentation determines the end of app start.

name: profilesSampleRate
message: Removed in 10.0; the SDK no longer captures profiles and there is no replacement option.

name: enableLogs
message: Removed in 10.0 because logs are always enabled; delete the assignment and filter with beforeSendLog instead.

name: enableMetrics
message: Removed in 10.0 because metrics are always enabled; delete the assignment and filter with beforeSendMetric instead.

name: enableStandaloneAppStartTracing
message: Removed in 10.0; app start is always a standalone app.start trace on Android and iOS, so delete the assignment.

name: SentryFeedbackWidget
message: Removed in 10.0 (renamed to SentryFeedbackForm in 9.21); use SentryFeedbackForm.

name: SentryLogAttribute
message: Removed in 10.0; use SentryAttribute with its typed factories, such as SentryAttribute.string(...).

name: startTransaction
message: Inert in stream mode, the default since 10.0; use Sentry.startSpan, or set options.traceLifecycle = SentryTraceLifecycle.static to keep transactions.

name: beforeSendTransaction
message: Inert in stream mode, the default since 10.0; move the logic to beforeSendSpan, or set options.traceLifecycle = SentryTraceLifecycle.static.
